items.headline: $COMP Jumps 27%, Beating Bitcoin and Ether
items.summary: $COMP surged 27%, leading both $BTC and $ETH over 7 and 28 days, even as Compound's TVL stays below late-September levels.

items.headline: $PENDLE Daily Volume Hits $159M, Led by Ethereum
items.summary: $PENDLE trading volume spiked to $159 million in a day, with Ethereum driving $121.5 million of it while TVL rose only modestly.

items.headline: $NEAR Opens Vote to Slash Token Issuance to 1.6%
items.summary: $NEAR's HSP-029 proposal would cut token issuance to 1.6% over 24 months after a 90-day grace period, pending a validator network upgrade.

items.headline: $STRK Gets Privacy Boost With New Bramble Wallet
items.summary: Starknet Foundation launched Bramble, a Chrome wallet with STRK20 shielding, private balances, Ledger signing and multisig support for $STRK users.

items.headline: $TIA Activates Fibre for Direct Validator Uploads
items.summary: Celestia turned on Fibre, letting rollups upload 128 MiB blobs directly to validators — a big scaling step for the $TIA ecosystem.
